reason: A DeepSeek Harness web overlay for visualizing provider balances, session costs, daily spend, token buckets, pricing status, and local spending history, with periodic provider queries and ledger persistence.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中以可拖动的玻璃拟态面板展示提供商余额、会话费用、每日支出、令牌用量和本地账本统计。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness web overlay that displays provider balances, session costs, daily spending, token usage, pricing status, and local ledger statistics.

capabilities: Displays provider balances, session costs, daily spend, token usage, and pricing information in a web overlay
Polls provider endpoints and performs manual balance and pricing refresh requests
Reads configured provider credentials through the host environment for supported usage queries
Writes and maintains a local JSONL spending ledger and optional pricing snapshot
Exposes read-only state and ledger routes plus side-effecting refresh routes
